I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message to confirm I've noted the Thornbury Cloth Co. deadline: the signed order form is due 21 December.

Nothing else needed doing. The brain saves every channel message automatically, so his post is already on record. I searched the brain and found nothing that conflicts with the date. That search was keyword-only, though, so a matching record worded differently could have been missed.

A signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and Marcus posted it in that channel himself, so acknowledging it there was fine.
